name: Mailyard
description: Inboxes, transactional email, contacts, campaigns and automations on your own Cloudflare account.

required.why: Deploy Mailyard's Worker, with its Durable Objects (mailboxes, send pacing) and Workflows (imports, exports, campaign sends)
Store contacts, campaigns, templates and the delivery ledger
Store raw messages, attachments, uploads and exports
Create the send, inbound and webhook queues, and subscribe delivery events for your sending domains
Route your domain's inbound mail to your Mailyard inboxes
Read PDF and Office attachments as text for agents (Workers AI document conversion, free for documents; images are never sent)

optional.why: List your zones, so you can pick the domain to send and receive on
Write SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records, and turn on Email Routing for a receiving subdomain
Count the mail Email Routing rejects before it reaches Mailyard (SPF, DKIM, DMARC failures)

secrets.name: DEFAULT_FROM
secrets.ask: Sender used when a send names none, e.g. "Acme <hello@acme.com>"

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.ask: Password for an SMTP mailbox used only as a fallback when Email Service is unavailable

secrets.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET
secrets.ask: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key, so signup forms with a site key turn bots away
secrets.help: Cloudflare dashboard → Turnstile → your widget → Settings

secrets.name: CLASSIFIER_API_KEY
secrets.ask: API key for the OpenAI-compatible spam classifier, if you turn it on

secrets.name: ASSISTANT_API_KEY
secrets.ask: API key for the OpenAI-compatible model behind the mailbox and audience helpers, if you use one

settings.name: MAILYARD_UNDO_SECONDS
settings.label: Undo send window
settings.help: Seconds a mailbox send waits so it can be undone. 0 sends at once.

settings.name: MAILYARD_REPLY_TARGET_HOURS
settings.label: Reply target
settings.help: Hours a conversation may wait for a reply before the Overview lists it as waiting.

settings.name: MAILYARD_TRACK_OPENS
settings.label: Track opens in new campaigns
settings.help: A tracking pixel; Apple Mail's privacy proxy opens are counted apart. Each campaign can switch it off.

settings.name: MAILYARD_TRACK_CLICKS
settings.label: Track clicks in new campaigns
settings.help: Links go through a redirect on your domain. Each campaign can switch it off.

settings.name: MAILYARD_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
settings.label: Public address
settings.help: Where people open the app, e.g. https://mail.example.com. Unsubscribe, view and tracking links use it; other hostnames redirect app pages here. Empty: each request's own address.

settings.name: MAILYARD_CLASSIFIER
settings.label: Spam classifier for inbound mail
settings.help: Off keeps the rules-based checks (SPF, DKIM, DMARC and your rules).

settings.name: MAILYARD_ASSISTANT
settings.label: Model for summaries, reply drafts, categories and segments
settings.help: Each helper is also off until turned on in Settings, Assistant, with a daily cap per mailbox.

settings.name: ASSISTANT_MODEL
settings.label: Assistant model
settings.help: Workers AI defaults to @cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash; an OpenAI-compatible endpoint needs one.

settings.name: ASSISTANT_URL
settings.label: Assistant endpoint
settings.help: The API base (https://api.openai.com/v1) or its chat completions URL.

settings.name: AI_GATEWAY_ID
settings.label: AI Gateway
settings.help: Route Workers AI calls through this gateway, for logs, caching and spend limits.

settings.name: SMTP_HOST
settings.label: Fallback SMTP host
settings.help: Used only when Email Service is unavailable.

routes.why: Show the daily sending quota on the Overview
Show sending reputation and warn before Cloudflare suspends sending
Read Cloudflare's suppression list beside Mailyard's own
Add an address to Cloudflare's suppression list when you push one
Push an imported suppression list to Cloudflare in batches
Remove an address you unsuppress from Cloudflare's list too
List verified forwarding addresses, so a mailbox can forward to them
Find the delivery-events queue, to check each sending domain's events reach it
Check each sending domain's delivery events are subscribed to Mailyard's queue
Find the zone a domain lives in, and list zones to pick a domain from
Show whether DNSSEC is on for a domain
Read a domain's DMARC record before changing it
Add a missing DMARC record when you fix a domain
Change a domain's DMARC policy when you ask
Re-add Email Routing's MX, SPF and DKIM records when you fix a receiving domain
Find a routing rule that already sends a new mailbox's address elsewhere
Point that address's routing rule at Mailyard, when you choose to
Read a sending subdomain's records and complaints
Set up a sending subdomain when you fix a domain
Re-apply a sending subdomain's records when you fix a domain
Count complaints for a sending domain on its screen

graphql.name: MailyardRoutingRejections
graphql.why: Count, per day, the mail Email Routing refused on your receiving zones, and why (DMARC, SPF, DKIM), for the overview

cost.typicalMonthlyUsd: $5 Workers Paid minimum; light use (under 3,000 emails a month) stays inside it. Beyond that, see cost.units (Cloudflare pricing pages, 2026-10-17).

units.included: Workers, KV, Hyperdrive and Durable Objects usage
